intro:
Welcome to **GalaxySMP**, a friendly survival server for everyone. Build, trade, play minigames and hang out with the community.

Pick a topic on the left to learn the basics. When you're ready, go back and press **Play**.

servers.name: GalaxySMP
servers.description: Survival with plots, jobs, shops and a friendly community

servers.name: The Sift
servers.description: A glowing land far away. Tame Dumplings and Blubs, and watch out for Sifters at night!

tabs.title: Getting Started
tabs.text:
**Your first steps**
- Type **/daily** every day for free rewards.
- **/quests** and **/achievements** give you money and goals.
- **/spawn** takes you back to spawn, **/rtp** sends you into the wild.
- Save spots with **/sethome**, go back with **/home**.
- Lost? **/guide** opens the full help menu.

tabs.title: Plots
tabs.text:
**Your own plot**
- Type **/plot** to claim a plot near spawn. Only you (and the friends you add) can build there.
- **/plot upgrade** makes it bigger.
- You can sell or rent out your plot with **/plot sell** and **/plot rent**.

tabs.title: Money & Store
tabs.text:
**Earning money**
- Pick a job with **/jobs** and get paid for mining, farming and more.
- Sell items with **/sell**, or list them on the Auction House with **/ah sell <price>**.
- Pay friends with **/pay**.

**The Store**
Plans, crate keys and more are on **galaxymc.us/store**.

tabs.title: Voice Chat
tabs.text:
**Talk while you play**
1. Go to **galaxymc.us** and sign in.
2. Get your code and type **/link <code>** here.
3. Open the Voice page on the website. People near you in game hear you.

tabs.title: Minigames
tabs.text:
**Play together**
- Type **/minigames** for Bedwars, Parkour and the Build Contest.
- Win to climb the leaderboards on the website.
